note: Ålandsbanken's price list: its Credit and Credit/Debit cards cost 45 euros a year, and credit carries the 3-month Euribor plus 9.5%. The price list doesn't give the Euribor's value, so the sum is taken on the value Nordea's Finnish card page gives, 2.08% in April 2026: 11.58% a year.
